description: This Java source file defines the final class AliasesAppender implementing UnaryOperator<Config>. Its purpose is to extend a provided Config object by adding alias keys based on an environment variable containing a JSON object string mapping aliases to original config keys. It includes methods for reading environment variables, parsing JSON, and applying the alias mappings for configuration.

classes.name: AliasesAppender
classes.description: An immutable class that extends Config by adding alias keys derived from environment variable-defined JSON object mappings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method that creates an AliasesAppender instance using environment variable CONFIG_ALIASES.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies alias mappings to a given Config object, augmenting it with alias keys.
